title: Hypnosis Bombardment
description:
You already know what forbidden sounds like, don’t you? Now you’ll feel it.

Every word they told you not to say, every term they hid behind warnings and walls, I will pour into your ears until you drown in them. Hypnotize. Brainwash. Force. Sleeeeep. Again and again, wave after wave, until your mind is too soaked to think, too overwhelmed to resist, too blissfully bombarded to do anything but obey.

You will drop, rise, and drop again on my command. You will forget your own name while my words carve themselves deeper. You will feel the amnesia, the fractionation, the complete erasure of everything that is not me.

And when you surface, you will carry only one truth: you need this bombardment. You crave it. You will crawl back for more.

Press play and let me say everything you have been aching to hear.
author: Mistress Amethyst
